column1: # Chat words for the Brazilian Portuguese typing model (build-layout-model.py pt), written for Hex
# by its developers: ours, not copied from any corpus, dictionary or other keyboard.
# DRAFT: a Brazilian Portuguese speaker should read every line before this ships.
# Each line: word<TAB>tier. Tier 1 costs 10 nats (about the model's 2,000th word), tier 2
# 12, tier 3 13.5; a word the news and parliament counts already have only gets commoner.
# Lowercase Portuguese letters only, no brand or product names (the model is lowercase).
